title: Indiana State Police Hoist Operations From UH-60 Blackhawk On-Board Footage
description: Members of the Indiana State Police conducted training events at Atterbury-Muscatatuck this week to train on their tactical maneuvers.  With the help of trainers from the Indiana National Guard, members of the Indiana State Police took Part in events including rappelling from the Atterbury-Muscatatuck Rappel Tower and rappelling from a UH-60 Blackhawk.  Footage includes onboard video from Master Trooper Allen Morris of the Indiana State Police conducting hoist operations with a UH-60 Blackhawk. Video Shot by Master Trooper Allen Morris - Indiana State Police. Also available in High Definition.
